summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 Report on the Brazilian Corporate Governance Code. The report discusses the company's dual-class share structure (common and preferred shares) and its shareholders' agreement. There are no transactional terms, no special-situation events, and no material corporate action disclosed. This is a routine governance disclosure by a foreign issuer. The filing does not trigger any special-situations category such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. It is merely an informational report under SEC rules for foreign private issuers.
